method.route: Six-minute flight loop with actual physics, touch input, auto resolution, rain, night and vehicle radio
method.limitations: Headless Chromium on a shared host; not a Redmi benchmark. Baseline mid-run overlapped Node tests; late comparison uses samples at 240 seconds and later. Different accumulated positions and actors limit direct FPS attribution.

race.note: Before inside laps were incorrectly invalidated by a hairpin projection discontinuity. All new tested laps valid; health 100.
